assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: landscape painted anime atelier background for a desktop app. IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET. IMAGE 2 IS ONLY A COSTUME-ORNAMENT reference, NOT a subject to insert. Correct the existing room so its design uses ONLY fabric, jewelry, and embroidery from the outfit, not any human or animal body shapes. PRESERVE the room's general warm muted cocoa/plum atmosphere, asymmetrical creative-workbench layout, vast quiet empty center suitable for UI text, rich dimensional anime illustration, desk at right, little 3D geometric models, hanging diamond ornaments. SPECIFIC CHANGES: remove all animal body representations completely. Replace the ear-shaped chair cover with an ordinary elegant burgundy upholstered chair with an ivory PLEATED fabric strip and small dark cherry satin bow. Replace the big curled tail cushion/left seat with an ordinary rounded velvet lounge seat in dark charcoal and cream PLEATED throw, no fur. Remove the paw-print cushion and replace with tiny gold botanical/diamond embroidery. Replace the paw-shaped window with one graceful oval/art-deco segmented window whose mullions form a faceted TEAL BROOCH diamond motif, no paw shapes. Remove paw-shaped brooches from fabric ties and use oval teal gemstones in antique champagne metal. Shift pink upper draping to muted dusty-rose ribbon and cherry-red sash, actual woven satin not hair. Reference image 2 only for dark cherry bow loops, cream skirt pleats, teal oval jeweled brooches, fine gold diamond chain and embroidery; distribute them as elegant decor at the outer edges. Dim the brightest cream lamps softly, comfortable for long viewing, middle 60% stays low-contrast and empty. Absolutely no people, faces, body parts, ears, hair, tails, paws, fur, animals, mascots, lettering, UI elements or watermark. All decorative shapes must visibly be cloth, metal, stone, wood, or glass. Keep wide 16:9 framing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one exquisitely designed transparent PNG ornamental UI frame for a desktop message composer, wide 3:1, perfectly front-on. Use ONLY the GARMENT ORNAMENTS and JEWELRY from the reference character: cherry-wine satin bow/sash, matte charcoal fabric, ivory accordion pleats and tiny gold embroidered star/diamond lines, oval teal gemstone brooch, fine champagne-gold geometric diamond chain. Do NOT include the character, head, body, hair, ears, animal features or shapes. Original wearable-jewelry-inspired frame construction: thin charcoal enamel rounded rectangular open outline, subtle champagne double piping with small angled metal corner plates. LOWER LEFT edge only has a modest asymmetric cherry waist bow tied through the metal, one tiny oval teal brooch and two short gold diamond hangings; a narrow elegant fan of ivory pleated fabric peeks from just under that knot along the bottom LEFT edge, less than 12% of width. Upper edge has a very small OFF-CENTER delicate gold embroidered star motif, with no centered bow and no lace. Other long stretches of border stay mostly plain, slim and useful for reading. A short diagonal cherry strap with little gold embroidery accents one lower corner, distinct from a royal fantasy lace frame. Premium detailed painted anime game UI, sculptural silk folds, crisp polished metal and jewel depth, low glare. Genuine transparent background AND fully transparent empty center opening, no solid panel, no checkered background. Keep all ornament completely inside the canvas with adequate margin. No people, no faces, no skin, no hair, no ears, no tails, no paws, no fur, no animal silhouettes, no text, no buttons, no watermark. Elegant, coherent and specific to the costume, not a frame assembled from body parts.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one tall narrow 1:3 PNG navigation panel skin, genuinely transparent exterior outside the panel; interior is opaque deep charcoal/plum velvet. Use ONLY garment and jewelry ornaments visible on the reference outfit. DO NOT insert the character or ANY human/animal body element. Design a clean tall rounded rectangular charcoal-enamel frame with delicate champagne-gold metal piping. Near the TOP LEFT corner a SMALL asymmetrical dark cherry SATIN bow and OVAL TEAL gemstone brooch with one short diamond-shaped hanging charm; it should resemble her collar jewelry, delicate and detailed, not a crown. A slender cherry ribbon runs diagonally across a very small area of the bottom with fine gold star embroidery, two tiny metal diamond charms; an IVORY accordion-pleated fabric ruffle folds under the bottom edge on just one side, echoing her skirt hem rather than generic scalloped lace. Keep ornament concentrated in the top 10% and bottom 12%, long sides nearly plain. The central 85% must stay uniformly very dark cocoa/charcoal velvet, low-contrast, completely empty for navigation UI. Premium dimensional anime game UI material painting with sophisticated restraint, accurate physical folded satin/pleats, gold and faceted gem. Genuinely transparent OUTSIDE the full rectangular frame, no white page or black backdrop; the inside remains solid dark velvet. No head, face, human, body, skin, hair, ears, tails, paws, fur, animal motifs or silhouettes. No text, no logo, no buttons or menu mockup, no huge centered ribbon, no rococo filigree and no curtains. Entire asset visible with clear padding, beautifully designed ORIGINAL costume-based decoration.
